about: The record holds severe gastro-oesophageal reflux disease and no proton pump inhibitor is supplied anywhere in the 9-month history.
The record holds severe gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, but esomeprazole (Nexium 40 mg, a proton pump inhibitor) is supplied every month from January to September 2026, so nothing is omitted.

Possible omission: the only proton pump inhibitor course ended on 7 June 2026 before severe reflux began on 15 July. The missing fact is "Current proton pump inhibitor use for the qualifying reflux or stricture".
